title: Top Jump Starters for Winter Breakdowns (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products that appear in at least two of the cited sources (Consumer Reports, PCMag, CNET, AutoWeek, GoMyReview, Web Archive).
assumptions: Prices are not listed in the sources, so no price information is included.

verdict.line: Drivers with standard passenger cars or small SUVs should buy the NOCO Boost GB40 because it delivers 1,000 A peak power, fits in a glovebox, and includes a 100‑lumen flashlight. It is the only model in this guide that offers a built‑in light and a weight of only 2.4 lb. The catch: it can’t start very large engines.
